name: Jiangxi Hongcheng Environment Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Hongcheng Environment Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and supplies tap water in China. The company engages in municipal water supply and drainage engineering design; water pollution prevention and control; environmental protection consulting service; supply of solar photovoltaic power; sale and installation of natural gas; sale of vehicle natural gas and specialty chemical products; water quality testing and operation; solid waste disposal; and construction, operation, and maintenance of municipal pipe network facilities.
